# Market context

## Findings

- Across our 40 depots, mean dwell time rose from 2.6 to 3.1 hours between January and March (depot operations log).
- Pickup windows must be configurable in 15-minute steps.
- In the Rotterdam trial, 11 of 14 drivers completed the new handover flow without help.
- Hypothesis: shippers who see live tracking will contact support less; this is untested.
- Carrier on-time delivery was 91% last quarter (carrier scorecard, Q3).
- A booking can hold up to ten parcels.
